page_title: ALM 2-2 VAL | Almeria v Valencia 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's the end of the match.
90+11' The ball is out of play and Almeria manage to earn a corner.
90+11' Leo Baptistao (Almeria) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
90+10' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield. Almeria earn a corner.
90+8' Substitution. Hugo Duro makes way for Mario Dominguez (Valencia).
90+7' Ruben Baraja is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Diego Lopez suffers an injury and Hugo Gonzalez (Valencia) comes on.
90+7' The game is interrupted now, Diego Lopez (Valencia) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
90+6' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' Largie Ramazani (Almeria) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
89' Selim Amallah (Valencia) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Luis Maximiano was alert and made a comfortable save.
87' Substitution. Andre Almeida did his best and is replaced by Pablo Gozalbez (Valencia).
86' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) attempts to discuss the decision with Mateo Busquets Ferrer, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.

78' Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer has finally had enough of Vicente Moreno and brandishes a yellow card at him!

68' Ibrahima Kone (Almeria) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.

57' Almeria failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' Great teamplay by Almeria as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

51' Fran Perez (Valencia) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
51' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pepelu (Valencia) takes it short.

45+2' Valencia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45+1' Luis Suarez (Almeria) gathers the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot. The ball, though, only brushes the left post. The ball goes out of play and Valencia will have a goal kick.

35' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) steps up to send the ball in.
35' Giorgi Mamardashvili makes a difficult save to deny Luis Suarez (Almeria), who attempted to head into the roof of the net from inside the box.

33' Neat passing move from Almeria in order to create new attacking opportunities.

30' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
28' Gonzalo Melero (Almeria) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for a foul.
25' Andre Almeida (Valencia) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Luis Maximiano.
23' Luis Suarez (Almeria) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
22' Rough tackle by Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Andre Almeida (Valencia) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
21' The Valencia players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' The game is interrupted. Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Almeria.
16' Mateo Busquets Ferrer interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Andre Almeida (Valencia).
14' 0 - 1 Diego Lopez (Valencia) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Luis Maximiano with a strike into the right side of the goal. He makes it 0:1.
13' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Valencia.
11' Diego Lopez (Valencia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' A cross from Sergio Akieme (Almeria) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
8' A crossfield pass from Adrian Embarba (Almeria) fails to find any of his teammates.

4' Luis Suarez (Almeria) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
